ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark-grey to black) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters occupying approximately 15-20% of the visible surface area localized at the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black region spanning the central and medial fluke. Distal tips exhibit high-contrast white mottling; the right lobe contains a larger, more contiguous white geometric blob (approx. 40x60 pixels in relative scale) compared to the more fragmented mottling on the left lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge with irregular peaks and valleys; serrations appear more jagged and have higher pixel amplitude on the outer halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the medial section toward the distal tips, creating a shallow 'U' or 'V' shaped profile across the total fluke span.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of roughly 5-7 circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized on the outer margin of the right fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear markings visible within the white pigmented zone of the right lobe distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white circular barnacles/lesions on the right distal tip; irregular jagged notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant foreground occlusion of the central fluke area and median notch by a bird in flight.
